title: Week 3
verification_note: Tuesday early card built on DraftKings' own numbers, pulled through The Odds API at 21:08 UTC 2026-09-22 (383 requests remaining this month). Three sides clear Rule A (+0.015 combined_edge): Arizona Cardinals ML +370 (+0.022), Las Vegas Raiders +3 (+0.015), and Miami Dolphins ML +575 (+0.015). Only the first two also carry a stated Rule 2 reason the number moves before Sunday; Dolphins ML is on the watch list, not a ticket, until Tua Tagovailoa's status and Kansas City's injury report firm up. Week 2's Thursday and Monday tickets are graded below from final scores (WebSearch); season carried forward.

tickets.name: Cardinals ML
tickets.why: combined_edge +0.022, best on the 16-game board. Brock Purdy remains out for SF (Mac Jones starts again); Kyler Murray is fully healthy for Arizona. The line already moved 3 points toward Arizona this week (open -11.5 to now -8.5), but public money is still lopsided on SF (~80% of tickets/handle) even as the number moves the other way.
tickets.kill_switch: If Brock Purdy is upgraded to probable/active at Wednesday or Thursday's practice report, pull this ticket -- SF getting its real starting QB back erases the edge. Also pull if the price shortens past +320.

legs.label: Cardinals ML
legs.why: combined_edge +0.022; own estimate 23.5% clears DK's 21.3% breakeven and matches Pinnacle's 23.5% fair. Purdy out again for SF, Murray fully healthy for ARI; public money still ~80% on SF despite the line's move toward Arizona this week.

tickets.name: Raiders +3
tickets.why: combined_edge +0.015. Sits exactly on the key number 3; Pinnacle already rates the Raiders half a point better (+3.5 fair). Saints are drawing public money as the home favorite (~56-64% of early-week action) and starting LT Kelvin Banks Jr. (high-ankle, surgery reported, possible IR) is a real, not-fully-priced hit to New Orleans' offensive line.
tickets.kill_switch: If Kelvin Banks Jr. is confirmed active/not on IR by Thursday, or the number moves off the key number to Raiders +2.5, or the price worsens past -115, pull this ticket.
